## Materials Scientist Interview-Dr. Raghunanadan Ummethala speaks dominance of metallic materials

News Date : 28 Sep 2023News ReportDespite the advancements in modern engineering, traditional metallic materials still dominate structural applications. More than 60% of biomaterials used today are made up of alloys.Raghunandan Ummethala (PhD), R&D Manager at nanoCaps (Norway), works on process development in order to scale up and commercialize the production of high energy density supercapacitor electrodes. Raghunandan talks to Shyam Krishnamurthy from The Interview Portal about the huge potential of materials science in both stationary (eg., smart grids) and mobile (eg., electric vehicles) applications. For students, sometimes the easiest way to build your career is to explore everything as a child or in your youth, and discover what fascinates you the most !
